description: A charming candid snapshot taken in December 1953 showing a glamorous young mother in a patterned one-piece bathing suit sitting on a wide, striped outdoor mattress on a sunny lawn. She holds her smiling young child on her lap while another toddler in a checkered romper reaches up towards them. In the background are mid-century aluminum lawn chairs with towels draped over them and a palm tree base, evoking a warm winter vacation or resort in a sunny climate such as Florida or California.
